title: Honey’s Beach Rental | Designer 30A Condo | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Pet-friendly WaterColor condo on Cerulean Park, just steps to the Beach Club and pools, with park views, bikes, designer interiors, and walkable dining.
description_expanded: Honey's Beach House Features - 2 Blocks to WaterColor Beach Club - 2 Blocks to Boathouse Pool - On Cerulean Park - beautiful views from the patio - Pet Friendly for up to 2 dogs, 45 pounds or less, and non-shedding. Approval from Exclusive 30A and payment of a non-refundable pet fee is required prior to your arrival. - Flexible summer stays available - Explore WaterColor and 30A with the provided Taxi bikes. Two bikes are included with your stay and additional rentals are available - Next to shopping and dining including Wine World and Scratch Biscuit Kitchen - No contact check-in! - First Floor Corner Unit - all one level - Spacious floor plan for 8 guests - Parking for 1 vehicle in parking lot behind building on a first come, first serve basis. Additional community parking available throughout neighborhood on first come, first serve basis - Open-air patio with cushioned seating and ottomans overlooking Cerulean Park - Screened-in porch with dining area for 4 overlooking Cerulean Park - Cable and WIFI - Full Kitchen with stainless steel GE appliances plus Keurig and Cuisinart drip coffee maker - Dining table with seating for 6 plus breakfast bar seating for 4 - Laundry closet with stacked washer and dryer - Access to WaterColor Beach Club, Camp Watercolor, and WaterColor Community Pools included with your reservation for 6 guests, age 5 and older. Community pools heated during cooler months (subject to change by the neighborhood) - Low Speed Vehicle (Golf cart) rentals are restricted at this location as access to charging outlets cannot be guaranteed - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Welcome to Honey's Beach House! This renovated condo in the heart of WaterColor is perfect for your crew of 6. The designer interiors are as comfortable as they are chic, and this location is difficult to beat. Walk out of the 1st floor, one-story condo onto Cerulean Park. This beautifully landscaped park is one of the most cherished locations in WaterColor. You can hear the famous fountain from the screened-in porch! Nestled on Cerulean Park you will be thrilled to feed your need for relaxation at this wonderful condo. Only 2 blocks to the WaterColor Beach Club, 2 blocks to the Boathouse Pool, and near shopping and dining, you may never need to get in your car while still being able to enjoy the best WaterColor and 30A has to offer. Walk to the Beach Club in 400 footsteps! Access included with your reservation as well as access to Camp WaterColor and all other community pools. Area Construction - Our area is getting more popular each year! There is ongoing construction nearby the condo. Additional community changes and projects on the roads and bridges along 30A year-round and throughout every single community are ongoing. Please be aware that refunds will not be issued due to noise disturbance or unsightly views due to nearby projects. ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***
rooms_guidance: King Suite | TV, ceiling fan, dresser, and armoire storage, reading chair, ensuite bath with enclosed bath area with tub and walk-in shower with spa and handheld shower heads

Guest Suite | Sleeps up to 4 in two Queen beds, TV, ceiling fan, dresser and reach-in closet storage, ensuite entrance to full bath with combination shower/tub (additional hallway access to bath also available)
Bonus | Queen Sleeper Sofa in the living room

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
